description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Squee dies, triggering Anax, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
